trap.label: sail
trap.wrong: The boat navigates close-hauled in this wind.
trap.right: The boat sails close-hauled in this wind.
trap.why: Em português “navegar” é universal. Em inglês, o barco sails; navigate é planejar a rota.

fix.wrong: We tacked for avoid the shore.
fix.right: We tacked to avoid the shore.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com sails: “The boat navigates upwind.”
Reescreva com to: “We tacked for avoiding the shore.”
rewrite.answer: We tacked to avoid the shore.
